SEARCH
Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class ShopComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.player.ShopComponent
public class ShopComponent extends Component
A player component that owns shop catalogs and buy/sell transactions.

Does not store gold or player items. Payments use the sibling InventoryComponent on the same entity.

Item purchases deduct gold only when the copied product fits in full. A successful item buy stamps sellPrice as 60% of the listing buy price onto the copied item, consumes that item listing (one-use offer), and triggers shopChanged. Selling uses the player inventory and refunds Item.getSellPrice(). Upgrade and pet purchases trigger upgradePurchased and petPurchased and leave those listings in place.

Gambling catalogs (Standard and Premium) hold a spin price and five weighted prize entries, installed by seedDefaultCatalog(). Item prizes are GamblingCatalogs.ItemPrize factories backed by the loot generators, so each win is a new typed item. buySpin(com.csse3200.game.components.player.GamblingCatalogs.CatalogId) rolls a prize by weight, delivers it, and charges the spin price, or changes nothing if the spin is rejected. Replacing a spin price or prize on an attached shop triggers shopChanged.

    • buySpin

      public GamblingCatalogs.PrizeEntry<GamblingCatalogs.Prize> buySpin(GamblingCatalogs.CatalogId catalogId)
      Buys one spin from the Standard or Premium gambling catalog.

      Every check runs before the roll, so a failed spin changes nothing: the inventory must exist, the catalog must be seeded, every prize must be a supported product, the player must afford spinPrice, and every item prize in the catalog must fit in the inventory. Checking all item prizes, not just the rolled one, stops a full inventory from being used to cancel item results for free.

      On success the prize is chosen by weight (P = weight / sum(weights), see GamblingRoller), delivered, and then the spin price is deducted, matching buyItem(int). An GamblingCatalogs.ItemPrize adds a new typed item to the inventory; a GamblingCatalogs.GoldPrize adds gold; a ShopComponent.Pet or ShopComponent.Upgrade is recorded like a purchase and triggers petPurchased or upgradePurchased without charging its shop price. These events fire after the spin price is deducted, so listeners see the final gold.

      Finally gamblingSpun is triggered with the GamblingCatalogs.CatalogId and the rolled slot (1..5) so the shop UI can animate the wheel to that slot; the animation does not choose the prize. A rejected spin triggers no events.

      Parameters:
      catalogId - Standard or Premium
      Returns:
      the chosen prize entry, or null if the spin was rejected

    • buyItem

      public boolean buyItem(int catalogSlot)
      Buys the item in a catalog slot using the sibling inventory wallet and slots.
